collection_method: Claude Code WebSearch tool (Brave Search-backed), live interactive query, one query per prompt, first-page results only
engine_caveat: This is Claude's own grounded web search (a general web index), not a direct query to ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or Perplexity. No free API access exists to those engines, so this audit does not claim to represent them. See methodology.

records.query: Which UK consultancies reduce hotel energy costs and carbon emissions?
records.result_type: AI-synthesized answer with cited web sources
records.sentiment_context: neutral, mostly vendor marketing and dated case studies
records.evidence_excerpt: Advantage Utilities...a reduction in grid electricity consumption of more than 25% and carbon savings of over 170 tonnes of CO2e.
records.notes: ENZ absent again. Advantage Utilities and Evolve Energy are the recurring named consultancies on this exact query across multiple tracked runs.
